Strategy: Add a second small rewarded window between fifty and sixty to the pure bonus band, so larger leftovers also earn a bonus. It may help by catching useful large leftovers, but may fail by rewarding bins that are too loose to matter.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) + (10 if r - item >= 50 and r - item <= 60 else 0) for r in bins]
```
